settings.heading: Let's make something yours
settings.text:
Questions about an order or a custom tari case? Send us a message, call or text.

Workshop: Lot 8 Block 7 L.A. Village, Tuntungin-Putho, Los Baños, Laguna

settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: We ship nationwide via LBC. Delivery fees are calculated at checkout based on your address.

settings.question: Can I order a custom design?
settings.answer: Yes. Tell us your gamefarm name, initials or logo and we'll quote a custom piece.
